861:t_000:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「In SRW, I'm the type who trains every unit evenly.」

861:t_000:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But this time, figuring out who to team up with who has me so wound up, I can't sleeeeeeep at night!」

861:t_000:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z', 'The Forbidden Tag Team'」

861:t_000:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「What am I supposed to do...!?」

861:t_001:3.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Good work! Now then, how about the ultimate break with me!」

861:t_001:5.en:
$$アンディ$$
「You bet! Where does a man's soul head...!? To digging holes...!」

861:t_001:7.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Dear players. I've sealed away $$アンディ$$, who'd drag you down the path of evil, along with the space itself.」

861:t_001:8.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Don't waste your thoughts on something as silly as digging holes. Make sure you get some proper rest.」

861:t_001:9.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「For the sake of $$アンディ$$'s soul, which has passed on...」

861:t_001:10.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Quit killing me off on your own!」

861:t_002:3.en:
$$シュレード$$
「My best friend... A message for the players taking a break, if you would.」

861:t_002:4.en:
$$カイエン$$
「I'll leave that sort of thing to you. Play them some of that violin you're so good at.」

861:t_002:5.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... Behind that cold front, you acknowledge my music, and even ask me to deliver it to the players...」

861:t_002:6.en:
$$シュレード$$
「What they call a tsundere.」

861:t_002:7.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Silence! Besides, nobody would be happy to see you and me turn up in a place like this!」

861:t_002:8.en:
$$シュレード$$
「That doesn't seem to be the case, though?」

861:t_002:9.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Ahh, the banter between $$シュレード$$ and $$カイエン$$... My head's spinning, I think I'm gonna get a nosebleed!」

861:t_002:10.en:
$$カイエン$$
「This is no way to take a break!」

861:t_003:3.en:
$$カグラ$$
「What, you're calling it quits here? Tch, what a wimp...」

861:t_003:4.en:
$$カグラ$$
「If you're a man, you go till morning, nice and long... If you're a woman, you go all night, nice and slow... right?」

861:t_003:5.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Whatever. I'll hold off on the real fun until the next battle.」

861:t_004:3.en:
$$クレア$$
「$$不動$$... I think I'll take a break too.」

861:t_004:4.en:
$$不動$$
「Then how about a donut for a sugar boost?」

861:t_004:5.en:
$$クレア$$
「A donut...? Where do you have such a thing?」

861:t_004:6.en:
$$不動$$
「This is the void at the center of a donut... In other words, the possibility of a donut...」

861:t_004:7.en:
$$不動$$
「That is, what makes a donut a donut is the infinite future born from this very spot...!」

861:t_004:8.en:
$$クレア$$
「...Do you think I can be convinced by words like that?」

861:t_004:9.en:
$$不動$$
「Heh... It seems the players share your sentiment. Well, until we meet again!」

861:t_005:3.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Step right up, customers! I've got some great photos! See anything you want?」

861:t_005:4.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「$$ミコノ$$? $$ゼシカ$$? $$ＭＩＸ$$? I've got $$ユノハ$$, Chairwoman $$クレア$$, and Instructor $$スオミ$$ too!」

861:t_005:5.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Or maybe you'd rather have... m-e?」

861:t_005:6.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「...Just kidding. Aww, I wish there was someone out there who'd look at only me!」

861:t_006:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Oh my, you're stopping here. What a shame, I wanted you to play with me a while longer.」

861:t_006:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Once I lend you my cooperation, maxed-out funds and hidden units would be yours at will, and yet...」

861:t_006:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Well, very well, I'll grant your wish another time. Now then...」

861:t_007:3.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Brittle~~~! Brittle~~~! And another one, brittle~~~! One more, brittle~~~!」

861:t_007:4.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「W-what are you doing, $$モロイ$$?」

861:t_007:5.en:
$$モロイ$$
「I'm crushing the players' resolve to study and their resolve to go to work. Now they'll surely feel like continuing the game.」

861:t_007:6.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「In that case, I'll make the players' motivation rot!」

861:t_008:3.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「The players are taking a break too, right? I look forward to the day we can meet again.」

861:t_008:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「U-um... $$ミコノ$$...! If you'd like, would you go to a movie with me during our break?」

861:t_008:5.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Eh... eh... If it's okay with me...」

861:t_008:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...Sorry, $$ゼシカ$$. I... I want to go with $$ミコノ$$, just the two of us.」

861:t_008:11.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Ahaha, I was only teasing you, $$アマタ$$! Go enjoy your date with $$ミコノ$$.」

861:t_008:12.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Sigh... So since that's how it is, all you players out there, comfort me, okay?」

861:t_009:3.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ジン$$, what are you doing in a place like this?」

861:t_009:4.en:
$$ジン$$
「N-nothing! I wasn't thinking about what combining is or anything like that!」

861:t_009:5.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「...I know, why don't we play SRW together, the two of us?」

861:t_009:6.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「It's really a single-player game, but I've never played, so I'd like you to teach me all sorts of things.」

861:t_009:8.en:
$$ジン$$
「(Ah... Could it be... this flutter in my heart... is combining...?)」

861:t_010:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Players, thank you for your hard work. Please rest well until your next play.」

861:t_010:4.en:
$$カグラ$$
「What kind of limp greeting is that! You got any killer drive in you, punk!? Show me some real snap!」

861:t_010:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You said it, $$カグラ$$! Then you show me a proper greeting!」

861:t_010:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Me too! If I put my mind to it!」

861:t_010:8.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Players. I... no, I mean, I'll be waiting for you all to come back!」

861:t_010:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't take too long coming back, damn it! Tu-la-la-la-la-la-la!」

861:t_011:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「What the hell, what the hell! You're quitting in a place like this!? I'm still hungry for more!」

861:t_011:4.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Stop it, $$アポロ$$! Not everyone is as tough as you are!」

861:t_011:5.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「That's right! Don't lump me in with $$アポロ$$!」

861:t_011:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Hah! Last thing I need is to hear that from the brute-strength airhead princess!」

861:t_011:7.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I will not allow you to insult my sister!!」

861:t_011:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I don't wanna hear it from $$シリウス$$ either, who keeps nervously resetting!」

861:t_011:9.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Brother! But you said that reset play was bad form, didn't you!?」

uncertain: 861:t_000:5: stage title 禁じられたタッグ rendered 'The Forbidden Tag Team' (タッグ = unit pairing in the game)
861:t_007:3-10: モロイ read as the pun 脆い (brittle, crushing resolve) -> 'Brittle~~~!'; サザンカ's 腐ッ read as rot/fujoshi 腐 -> 'Rot-rot-rot'
861:t_010:9: speaker is Amata, imitating Kagura's rough style; トゥララララララ kept as 'Tu-la-la-la-la-la-la!'
861:t_003:4: Kagura's innuendo (朝まで/夜通し たっぷり) kept suggestive but literal
861:t_011:5: シルヴィア's アポロと一緒にしないで taken as 'lump me in with Apollo'
